reviewTitle: Perfect for small muscle cramps in the feet
reviewDescription: Use it on my feet every night to get the little Charley horse cramps to ease up and it works almost immediately. The large muscle cramps you probably need a magnesium pill. I got a cramp in my thigh last night and it was so painful I slathered a ton of this lotion on, guzzled water, took a multivitamin but it wasn’t until my husband went downstairs and grabbed the magnesium pills that it finally relaxed. Ugggh!!
